dct_description_sm: Population Raster New Caledonia 2020 Data Input: Settlement footprint from Facebook's High-Resolution Population Density Maps https://data.humdata.org/dataset/new-caledonia-high-resolution-population-density-maps-demographic-estimates Population allocated proportionally using 2011 census population counts at enumeration area (districts de recensement) level. Year Population Growth Rate of 0.2% (0.001957) has been applied to update population up to 2020 The human settlement footprint with census population allocated has been converted into a 100 m resolution raster. _Access this dataset from the [Pacific Data Hub](https://pacificdata.org/data/dataset/ncl_population_grid_2020)_
